# dsh-widescreen
Widescreen mode for the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Adds a toggle in **Settings → General** (设置 → 通用设置)
that lets the session detail page fill the available browser width instead of the fixed 748px conte
the session detail page fill the available browser width instead of the fixed 748px content column.
## Features

- One switch in Settings → General: **Widescreen mode** (宽屏模式).
- When on, the chat column, date div
iders, question cards, and the composer card all expand to the full width of the center column — no

more excessive whitespace on wide monitors.
- When off, behavior is byte-for-byte the shipped defaul

t (748px content column).
- Container-relative sizing only (`--dsh-chat-content-width: 100%`): brows

er zoom and window resizing keep reflowing exactly as before, and narrow viewports are unaffected.
-
The preference is persisted in the DSH user-settings document; it survives page reloads and restart

s.
- Fully reversible: removing the plugin restores the default layout with no residue.

ion is ignored once the namespace is gone.
